blocking_findings.finding: routing_locator has PRIMARY KEY(respondent,target,risk_set,fact_ref); routing_locator_resp_idx repeats exactly the same column order. resource_findings.finding: No unbounded cross-call match cache was found: gids is local to one lookup generator and is discarded when _routing_fact_for finishes consuming it. It is bounded by the distinct physical gids touched by that lookup, but not by a fixed one-row-group bound. It bypasses session._row_group_cache, so repeated lookups reread groups. Qualification reports 40 lookup objects and 220 total row-group reads; that is not a reuse proof.

performance_and_measurement.reason: The author comparator builds both candidate and baseline _ReleaseIndex objects from the same candidate prepared session. baseline_index = replace(candidate_index, routing_lookup=None) disables only the adapter; it does not measure a separate baseline session build S or H. Candidate S=58.398 ms is candidate-only. H is outside timed scope. Parent maxrss is the only memory figure. Therefore the Q deltas (f4 40.731 vs 61.212 ms; f2 28.639 vs 39.734 ms) are a scoped same-session Q observation, not an end-to-end speedup and not a measured failure to amortize incremental S.
